grounding.observation: Actual24 front/reverse and stance/crest show viable underlying shirt but failed sash, crude crown/face and polished horse. This is recorded as failure, not incremental acceptance.
grounding.comparison: Preserve23/24 garment progress while addressing whole-character vetoes.

expert_coverage.observation: Costume support becomes one shoulder ribbon with front/back coverage and pose binding. Character/material lens addresses cylinder silhouette, rooted beard and plastic coat rather than more cloth noise alone.
expert_coverage.comparison: Actual rendering must decide if refinements are sufficient.

film_alignment.observation: Indigo/ochre identity and existing adult donor preserved. The intended read remains a credible supporting warrior in the accepted film, not a new cartoon style.
film_alignment.comparison: No lowering Pashtun floor to accommodate this candidate.

preferences.observation: Deliver coherent improvements together; no routine handoff over shader or binding choice.
preferences.comparison: Director only reviews a materially complete scoped result or real blocker.

reference_roles.observation: Accepted Pashtun establishes quality, not identity. Original rear reference and camera remain unchanged.
reference_roles.comparison: No still-image claim of performance fluidity.

method.observation: Continuous dense sash bridges small fold recesses, binds triangle offset frames to all source poses; layered crown replaces cylinder. Existing trusted body-fit pad and dark short-coat treatment are reused as candidates, not prequalified output.
method.comparison: Full standing/reverse/crest interfaces must discriminate failures of static pad fit and ribbon binding.

interfaces.observation: All four original motion owners and parent relationships preserved; eye and beard follow owners retained. Source-bound sash must clear garment and belt; pad must fit body and thighs through rearing.
interfaces.comparison: No art waiver from guarded native success.

efficient_quality.observation: One leader and the currently visible horse/tack, not every crowd member. Matched close and shot-scale images before propagation.
efficient_quality.comparison: No speculative future rig or full-film rerender.

authority.observation: Cycle25/max27 inside shared10,2 reserve. Local derivative only; no spend/installation/egress.
authority.comparison: No Director identity change or new service implied.

strongest_counterexample: A coherent front ribbon can still float over the shoulder or collide in the crest; procedural skin and broader beard may still read as a mannequin. Actual reverse and intended shot-scale comparisons must veto those, even with valid binding and successful reopen.
